client:os:cpu_affinity.description: Client host: CPUs the database process may run on (all / CPU list such as 1-3), e.g. to keep it off the CPUs handling network interrupts.

client:os:datadir_fs.description: Client host: Filesystem of the data directory on the experiment device (scope 'filesystem' only).

client:os:disk_write_cache.description: Client host: Volatile write cache of the data drive (hdparm -W / SCSI WCE / NVMe feature 6; none: the drive has none). ON without power-loss protection: DURABILITY TRADE-OFF.

client:os:fs.aio-max-nr.description: Client host: System-wide limit of in-flight asynchronous I/O requests (InnoDB native AIO).

client:os:hugepages.description: Client host: Number of 2 MiB huge pages reserved (used by the buffer pool when large_pages=ON).

client:os:kernel.numa_balancing.description: Client host: Automatic NUMA page migration (multi-socket hosts).

client:os:kernel.sched_autogroup_enabled.description: Client host: Group CPU time per terminal session (desktop feature).

client:os:malloc.description: Client host: Memory allocator for mysqld: glibc[:arena_max=N], jemalloc[:MALLOC_CONF], tcmalloc, mimalloc (LD_PRELOAD).

client:os:mount_barrier.description: Client host: ext4 write barriers (OFF = nobarrier: DURABILITY TRADE-OFF).

client:os:mount_noatime.description: Client host: Mount the data directory filesystem with noatime.

client:os:mysqld_numa_policy.description: Client host: NUMA memory policy of mysqld (default / interleave across all nodes / bind:N or preferred:N to one node), via systemd NUMAPolicy.

client:os:net.core.default_qdisc.description: Client host: Default queueing discipline (fq pairs with bbr).

client:os:net.core.netdev_budget.description: Client host: Packets processed per softirq round.

client:os:net.core.netdev_budget_usecs.description: Client host: Time budget per softirq round.

client:os:net.core.netdev_max_backlog.description: Client host: Per-CPU packet backlog before softnet drops.

client:os:net.core.rmem_max.description: Client host: Max receive buffer an application may set.

client:os:net.core.rps_sock_flow_entries.description: Client host: RFS global flow table.

client:os:net.core.somaxconn.description: Client host: Upper bound of listen backlogs (MySQL back_log is capped by it).

client:os:net.core.wmem_max.description: Client host: Max send buffer an application may set.

client:os:net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range.description: Client host: Ephemeral ports for outgoing connections (clients).

client:os:net.ipv4.tcp_congestion_contro.description: Client host: TCP congestion control algorithm (cubic / bbr).

client:os:net.ipv4.tcp_keepalive_intvl.description: Client host: Interval between keepalive probes.

client:os:net.ipv4.tcp_keepalive_probes.description: Client host: Keepalive probes before the connection is dropped.

client:os:net.ipv4.tcp_keepalive_time.description: Client host: Idle time before TCP keepalive probes.

client:os:net.ipv4.tcp_rmem.description: Client host: TCP receive buffer min/default/max (autotuning ceiling).

client:os:net.ipv4.tcp_slow_start_after_.description: Client host: Shrink the congestion window after idle (hurts pooled connections over WAN).

client:os:net.ipv4.tcp_tw_reuse.description: Client host: Reuse TIME_WAIT sockets for new outgoing connections (clients).

client:os:net.ipv4.tcp_wmem.description: Client host: TCP send buffer min/default/max.

client:os:net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max.description: Client host: Connection tracking table size (firewalled hosts).

client:os:net_irq_cpus.description: Client host: CPUs that handle the network card interrupts (auto / CPU list); irqbalance is stopped while managed.

client:os:read_ahead_kb.description: Client host: OS read-ahead of the data device (no effect on InnoDB data files opened with O_DIRECT).

client:os:rps.description: Client host: Receive Packet Steering over all CPUs for every RX queue (spreads softirq).

client:os:scheduler.description: Client host: Block I/O scheduler of the data device.

client:os:swapfile.description: Client host: Extra swap file managed by the agent (size, 0 = none): room for cold memory so caches can grow.

client:os:thp.description: Client host: Transparent Huge Pages (never / madvise / always).

client:os:vm.dirty_background_bytes.description: Client host: Dirty page cache that starts background writeback (affects buffered binlog/redo writes).

client:os:vm.dirty_background_ratio.description: Client host: Dirty page cache (% of memory) that starts background writeback (used when dirty_background_bytes is 0).

client:os:vm.dirty_bytes.description: Client host: Dirty page cache at which writers are throttled.

client:os:vm.dirty_expire_centisecs.description: Client host: Age at which dirty page cache must be written back.

client:os:vm.dirty_ratio.description: Client host: Dirty page cache (% of memory) at which writers are throttled (used when dirty_bytes is 0).

client:os:vm.dirty_writeback_centisecs.description: Client host: Interval of the background writeback thread.

client:os:vm.min_free_kbytes.description: Client host: Free memory the kernel keeps for atomic (network/driver) allocations.

client:os:vm.swappiness.description: Client host: Kernel preference for swapping anonymous memory (1 = only under real pressure).

client:os:vm.zone_reclaim_mode.description: Client host: Reclaim memory on the local NUMA node (drop cache, swap) before allocating on another node (0 = allocate remotely).

client:os:zswap.description: Client host: Compressed in-memory cache for swapped pages (off / on[:compressor]): cheaper swap-ins.
